query:
INSERT INTO draft (workspace_id, path, typ, value, created_at, email)
         SELECT $2, path, typ,
                CASE WHEN typ IN ('script', 'flow')
                     THEN to_json(to_jsonb(value) - 'on_behalf_of_permissioned_as')
                     ELSE value END,
                created_at, email
         FROM draft
         WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND (email = $3 OR email IS NULL)
